t: You're standing at the statue of Mozart on Orange Square in Belgravia. It was made by the Scottish sculptor Philip Jackson, who has acted as Royal Sculptor to Queen Elizabeth II. The statue stands near 180 Ebury Street, where Mozart briefly lived and composed his first symphony. Mozart completed more than 800 works in his life, including symphonies, concertos, chamber music, opera and choral music, and he is regarded as one of the greatest composers in the history of Western music.
